about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos and clips run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); story leaves the top bar and the reply field; feed is the 4:5 feed post: the grid crops it to a square from the center, so type stays clear of the top and bottom 135 px.
